description: QueryDef parameter round trip, text types: the same shape with Text(255) and LongText, for each r-wire cell of FText and FMemo (empty, embedded U+0000, astral pair, lone high and low surrogates, reversed pair, U+FFFE, odd-byte BSTRs of 1, 3 and 5 bytes, 255 and 256 and 300 and 5,000 units, 4,000 pairs, an 8,001-byte BSTR). Asks the Parameter read-back and the V field tag, BSTR byte length and payload.

args.text: PARAMETERS pV Text(255); SELECT pV AS V FROM One;
PARAMETERS pV LongText; SELECT pV AS V FROM One;
